Dr. Rashel Vitamin C Brightening & Anti-Aging Night Cream | Deep Repair & Skin Renewal Moisturizer (50 g)
Wake up to radiant, youthful skin with Dr. Rashel Vitamin C Brightening & Anti-Aging Night Cream, a luxurious overnight treatment designed to repair, rejuvenate, and brighten your skin while you sleep. Enriched with Vitamin C, Niacinamide, and Collagen, this powerful formula boosts skin elasticity, reduces fine lines, and fades dark spots for a visibly even and glowing complexion. The lightweight, non-greasy texture deeply penetrates the skin to deliver intense hydration and nourishment throughout the night. It helps repair daily damage, smooth rough texture, and restore natural radiance, leaving your skin soft, supple, and refreshed every morning.
Key Features:
Brightens dull and uneven skin tone overnight
Reduces fine lines, wrinkles, and signs of aging
Fades dark spots and promotes an even complexion
Boosts collagen production for firm, youthful skin
Deeply hydrates and nourishes skin while you sleep
Lightweight, non-greasy, and easily absorbed
Suitable for all skin types — daily night use
How to Use:
Apply every night on cleansed face and neck
Massage gently in upward circular motions until absorbed
For best results, use after Dr. Rashel Vitamin C Serum

Vitamin C: Brightens skin and fades dark spots
Niacinamide: Evens skin tone and smooths texture
Collagen: Improves firmness and reduces fine lines
Hyaluronic Acid: Locks in moisture for deep hydration
Antioxidants: Help repair damage and prevent premature aging
